claim: e02 estimates the interface forces from the Cauchy stress at the centre of the top / bottom layer hexes, 0.1 mm inside the cage, times the face area. It does not use the interface traction. The top and bottom shear forces therefore do not balance exactly. In p062 the imbalance reaches 2.2 N against about 10 N of face shear (~20 %, t 4.95), and 3.6 N in z at t 6.99. The cause is unverified: it could be sampling error or an extra load path on the cage. One candidate is that the release-step hold (fix x,y on node set cage_hold, release_hold_nodes 28057 / 29953) persists into the physio step. M2 / M3 shear values carry this uncertainty. The plot file already contains 'contact traction' / 'contact pressure' face data for surfaces 9 / 10 (cage_top / cage_bot), which could be used instead or as a cross-check.
evidence: roles/redteam/r0001_i001.py on p062: t 4.95 top F (-10.1, -3.0, -96.5), bot F (7.9, 2.9, 95.5), sum (-2.2, -0.1, -0.9) N; t 6.99 sum z 3.6 N; xplt face variables listed by the same script: ['contact pressure', 'contact force', 'contact gap', 'contact traction'], surfaces {9: cage_top, 10: cage_bot}. case.feb release step Boundary 'fix bc=x,y node_set=cage_hold' (r0001_loads.py); case.json release_hold_nodes [28057, 29953].

fix_options.option: Report F_top + F_bot and M balance per state in e02 and flag states with imbalance > 5 % of the face shear
Cross-check with the xplt contact traction of the tied surfaces (if written for the tied interface) or with nodal reaction sums
Check in the FEBio log / a reaction output whether the cage_hold constraint is still active in the physio step

summary_zh: 摩擦分析程式是用 cage 最上層與最下層元素中心的應力（在表面內 0.1 毫米處）乘以面積，來估計介面上的力，而不是直接讀取介面上的接觸力。在 p062 案例中，cage 上下兩面的剪力最多差了約 2.2 牛頓，而剪力本身只有約 10 牛頓，也就是約 20%。原因尚未確認：可能是取樣誤差，也可能是插入步驟中固定 cage 的兩個點，到了生理負荷步驟仍然有效。建議每個狀態都輸出上下兩面的力平衡檢查，並用模擬檔中已有的接觸力資料交叉比對。
